name: Slaying Blow
text: If the first Attack action in the next activation is a critical hit, double its Damage characteristic.

name: Lethal Strike
text: If the first Attack action in the next activation is a critical hit, double its Damage characteristic for that Attack action.

name: Bloody Axe
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atFury: 3 - :boom: 2] If this fighter has 2 or more wound tokens, double the Damage characteristic of this Attack action.

name: Frenzy
text: Roll an extra attack dice when this fighter makes a Charge action.

name: Brutal Charge
text: Roll an extra attack dice when this fighter makes a Charge action.

name: Glory to Khorne
text: Roll one extra attack dice for the first Attack action made by a friendly fighter in the next activation.

name: Brave Strike
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: 2] Roll an extra attack dice if there are no adjacent friendly fighters.

name: Venomous Blood
text: Reaction: Play this during a Range 1 or Range 2 Attack action that targets a friendly fighter, after the deal damage step. Stagger the attacker, then deal 1 damage to the attacker if the target has one or more poison upgrades.

name: Shadow Keeper
text: (Errata update) Illusion, Denizen Do not spend any glory points when you play this card. At the end of the action phase, or when this fighter is chosen by a gambit or is dealt damage, break this card. This fighter is on Guard. Reaction: After an enemy fighter's failed Attack action, if this fighter was the target, was adjacent and there was one or more :dfCrit: in the defence roll, deal 1 damage to the attacker.

name: Spiteful Mouths
text: Reaction: Use this when this fighter is the target of an Attack action, after the determine success step, if this fighter's defence roll contained one or more successes or critical successes. If the attacker is within 2 hexes of this fighter, deal 1 damage to the attacker.

name: Shadewalker
text: This fighter has the Flying trait. +1 Move.

name: Magnificent Bounda
text: This fighter is flying. +1 Move.

name: Silent Bracers
text: (Errata update) The Flying trait replaces the similar ability on this card. Silent Relic This fighter is a Quarry. If this fighter is a Quarry, this fighter can move through blocked and occupied hexes, but must end their move in an empty hex. If this fighter's Move action begins in non one's territory, this fighter has +2 Move for the duration of that action. +1 Move if this fighter has two or more Silent Relics.

name: Incredible Agility
text: (Errata update) The Flying trait replaces the similar ability on this card. In the next activation, friendly fighters other than Kyrae treat lethal hexes as normal hexes and can move through occupied hexes, but cannot end their move in an occupied hex.

name: Flying High
text: Hybrid: Score this in an end phase if: There are more flying friendly fighters in enemy territory than there are enemy fighters in your territory Or: Three or more surviving friendly fighters are Inspired.

name: Armed to the Teeth
text: This fighter's Range 1 Attack actions have Knockback 1. This fighter's Range 2 Attack actions have Ensnare. This fighter's Range 3+ Attack actions have Cleave.

name: Surfaced Instinct
text: When this fighter is the target of an Attack action, ignore the rules for Cleave and Ensnare.

name: Shadow Spear
text: Attack action [:Hex: 2 - :atSmash: 3 - :boom: 2 -(Cleave)-] This fighter cannot make this Attack action unless this fighter is in a cover hex.

name: Armour of the Cythai
text: -1 Dice from adjacent fighters' Attack actions that target this fighter, to a minimum of 1.

name: Visage of Destruction
text: Illusion Do not spend any glory points when you play this card. At the end of the action phase, or when this fighter is chosen by a gambit or is dealt damage, break this card. This fighter is a hunter. -1 Dice from adjacent enemy fighter's Attack actions that target this fighter, to a minimum of 1.

name: Remembered Shield
text: This fighter's Defence characteristic changes to :dfBlock:.

name: Phantasmal Forms
text: In the next activation, friendly fighters have a Defence characteristic of :dfDodge: 3.

name: Arcanite Shield
text: This fighter's Defence characteristic changes to :dfBlock:.

name: Fateful Strike
text: Surge: Score this immediately after a friendly fighter's successful Attack action that targets a fighter with a Defence characteristic of 2 or more.

name: Instinctive Shield
text: When this fighter is given this upgrade, place one shield counter on this card, plus one shield counter if this fighter is a wizard. Reaction: After this fighter is dealt damage, before checking if this fighter is taken out of action, remove the shield counters from this card. If you do Heal (X) this fighter, where X is the number of shield counters you removed.

name: Aetherically Charged Shield
text: Once per game, after the opponent picks a weapon to attack a friendly shield-bearer: weapon abilities cannot be used for that Attack.

name: Aetherically Charged Maul
text: Once per game, after you pick a weapon for an Attack by a friendly shield-bearer: the weapon has +1 Range for that Attack.

name: Weighty Blessing
text: Mutation Choose one friendly fighter, then put one Shield counter or one Magic counter on this card. The chosen fighter has -1 Move, to a minimum of 0, and the following benefit, depending on which you picked: Shield: +1 Defence Magic: This fighter's Attack actions have Cleave.

name: Deathly Apotheosis
text: Choose one friendly fighter. While that fighter has Bloodthirst, give that fighter one Hunger counter at the end of the action phase and Heal (1) that fighter each time that fighter is given one or more Hunger counters. While that fighter is Inspired, you can re-roll one dice in the fighter's attack rolls. This effect persists until that fighter is taken out of action.

name: Inspiring Mascot
text: Denizen You cannot give this to a leader or a Large fighter. At the end of the action phase, Heal (1) this fighter, then push this fighter up to 1 hex.

name: Gifted Vitality
text: Mutation You cannot give this to a Large fighter. At the end of the action phase, Heal (1) this fighter. Reaction: After a friendly fighter's Attack action that takes an enemy fighter out of action, if this card is in your hand, give this upgrade to that friendly fighter. This does not cost any glory points.

name: Quick Learner
text: Reaction: After an enemy fighter's Attack action or another warband's gambit that damages this fighter but does not take them out of action, draw a power card.

name: Looncourt, Scrag 'Em!
text: Dual, Quest: You can give this to a friendly fighter that has no tokens or Quests in the power step in place of playing a card (do not draw a replacement). If this fighter is taken out of action, add this card to your hand (even if you have three or more objective cards). Score this in an end phase if: This fighter is adjacent to two or more fighters And: One or more of those fighters is a friendly fighter.

name: Kindred Affinity
text: At the start of the action phase, draw the top card of your power deck and reveal it. If that card is a Denizen upgrade, give that upgrade to this fighter (this does not cost any glory points). Otherwise, add that card to your hand.

name: Neh Neh Na-neh Neh!
text: Surge, Quest: You can give this to a friendly fighter that has no tokens or Quests in the power step in place of playing a card (do not draw a replacement). If this fighter is taken out of action, add this card to your hand (even if you have three or more objective cards). Score this immediately after an enemy fighter's Attack action that targets this fighter and fails.

name: Bag of Tricks
text: Action: Search your power deck for a card, reveal it and add it to your hand. Then shuffle your power deck and place a Charge token next to this fighter.

name: That's Ours, That is!
text: Quest: You can give this to a friendly fighter that has no tokens or Quests in the power step in place of playing a card (do not draw a replacement). If this fighter is taken out of action, add this card to your hand (even if you have three or more objective cards). Score this in an end phase if this fighter is holding an objective with the same number as the current round number (e.g. Objective 2 in the second round).

name: Illusory Fighter
text: Choose one of your fighters on the battlefield. Place them on a starting hex in your territory.

name: Cycle of Decay
text: Score this in an end phase if you played two or more Cycle ploys in the preceding action phase.

name: Stick the Boot In
text: Reaction: Use this after a friendly fighter's activation, if that fighter is adjacent to one or more vulnerable enemy fighters that are adjacent to one or more other friendly fighters. Choose one of those vulnerable fighters, and deal 1 damage to the chosen fighter.

name: Sorcerous Flourish
text: Reaction: Play this after resolving a spell cast by a friendly fighter that damaged one or more enemy fighters. Choose one of those enemy fighters. That fighter suffers 1 damage.

name: Rampant Disease
text: Cycle Roll one attack dice for each enemy fighter adjacent to one or more friendly fighters. For each roll of :atCrit: that enemy fighter is dealt 1 damage.

name: Trust to Luck
text: Discard any number of power cards and draw up to that number of power cards from your deck.

name: Overthink
text: Draw one objective card, then pick one of your objective cards and put it on the bottom of your objective deck.

name: Dark Insight
text: While this fighter is in a cover hex, they can make the following action: Action: Look at the top card of your objective deck. Pick one: Draw that card and discard one objective card Or: Put that card on the bottom of your objective deck.

name: Witchlight Glimmer
text: This fighter is Inspired and cannot be un-Inspired. You can re-roll one dice in this fighter's attack rolls.

name: Exult in Violence
text: Score this in an end phase if two or more surviving friendly fighters are Inspired.

name: Gifted Ferocity
text: Mutation +1 Dice to this fighter's Range 1 Attack actions. Reaction: After a friendly fighter's Attack action that takes an enemy fighter out of action, if this card is in your hand, give this upgrade to that friendly fighter. This does not cost any glory points.

name: Countless Familiars
text: Denizen When you give this to a fighter, give that fighter and one other friendly fighter within 2 hexes one Familiar counter. While a fighter has one or more Familiar counters, that fighter is considered to have one additional Denizen upgrade.

name: Small Glories
text: Score this in an end phase if each surviving friendly fighter is Inspired and/or has one or more upgrades.

name: Burnt Out
text: Surge, Dual: Score this immediately after a power step if: You have no power cards in your hand And: You have not discarded and power cards in this round (cards that were played from your hand are not discarded).

name: Rampant Spellcasting
text: Hybrid: Score this in an end phase if: Your warband cast three or more spells in the preceding action phase Or: You have no power cards in your hand and three or more gambits in your power discard pile.

name: Improvisation
text: Discard all power cards in your hand and draw three power cards.

name: Silent Ring
text: Silent Relic This fighter is a Quarry. If this fighter is a Quarry, this fighter has the following reaction. Reaction: After this fighter's activation, if you have three or fewer power cards in your hand, draw one power card. +1 Dice to this fighter's Range 1 Attack actions if this fighter has two or more Silent Relics.

name: Summoner
text: Score this immediately the second or subsequent time you use Vortemis' action to summon a Blue Horror.

name: Dread Puppetry
text: Surge: Score this immediately after a friendly Regulus is given a Raise counter.

name: Arise!
text: Only if your leader has no Charge tokens: raise up to 2 slain friendly fighters on different empty starting hexes in your territory.

name: The Will of the Architect
text: Pick two feature tokens. Place each feature token in the hex the other feature token was in when you picked them.

name: Out My Way, Fool-Things!
text: Power step, once per game: a friendly fighter and another fighter adjacent to it swap places.

name: Quick Manoeuvre
text: Choose your leader and an adjacent friendly fighter. Switch their positions.

name: Confusion
text: Choose two fighters that are adjacent to each other and switch them.

name: Confused Priorities
text: Switch two objectives that are currently being held.

name: Oath of the Hunt
text: Dual: You may reveal this card at the start of your first turn in a round, then return it to your hand. Score this in an end phase if: Each surviving friendly fighter has one or more Charge tokens And: Each of those fighters is in enemy territory. If you revealed this card, gain one additional glory point.

name: Oath of Fortitude
text: Hybrid: You may reveal this card at the start of your first turn in a round, then return it to your hand. Score this in an end phase if: There are three or more surviving friendly fighters Or: There are one or more surviving friendly fighters and no friendly fighters were taken out of action in this round. If you revealed this card, gain one additional glory point.

name: Phantom Retrieval
text: Pick one or more Illusion upgrades in your discard pile. Then discard two power cards for each Illusion upgrade you picked. When you do, return the Illusion upgrades you picked to your hand.

name: Oath of Murder
text: You may reveal this card at the start of your first activation in the action phase, then return it to your hand. Score this in an end phase if your warband took an enemy leader out of action in the preceding action phase. If you revealed this card, gain 1 additional glory point.

name: Oath of Denial
text: You may reveal this card at the start of your first activation in the action phase, then return it to your hand. Score this in the third end phase if there are no enemy fighters in your territory. If you revealed this card, gain 1 additional glory point.

name: Firebomb
text: Pick one hex within 3 hexes of a friendly Krookgrin, then roll one attack dice. On a roll of :atCrit:, deal 1 damage to each fighter in or adjacent to that hex. Otherwise, scatter 2 from that hex. Deal 1 damage to each fighter in or adjacent to the end hex.

name: Grasping Rootgrave
text: Domain You cannot play this in the final power step of a round. At the end of the action phase, deal 1 damage to each fighter adjacent to a feature token. This effect persists until the end of the phase or until another Domain gambit is played.

name: Penumbral Falls
text: Waypoint At the end of the action phase, deal 1 damage to each fighter that is in an edge hex. This effect persists until another Waypoint is played.

name: Euphoric Dust
text: Poison Choose one enemy fighter adjacent to one or more friendly fighters. -1 Defence from that enemy fighter (to a minimum of 1) until the next power step.

name: Venombite Shank
text: Attack action, Poison [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 4 - :boom: 1 -(Cleave)-]

name: Blighted Touch
text: Poison Cleave, Ensnare, Knockback and Stagger cannot affect this fighter during Range 1 and Range 2 Attack actions that target this fighter if the attacker is affected by one or more persisting poison gambits.

name: Venombite Weapons
text: Poison Play this only if there are one or more poison gambits in your power discard pile. When you give this upgrade to a fighter, pick up to one poison gambit from your power discard pile and put it beneath this card. Reaction: After this fighter's successful Attack action, place the poison gambit beneath this card in your hand. Then pick up to one poison gambit from your power discard pile and put it beneath this card.

name: Master Poisoner
text: Score this in an end phase if you have played two or more Poison gambits.

name: Dance Without End
text: Reaction: After another friendly fighter's Move action, push this fighter 1 hex, or 2 hexes if you first deal 1 damage to this fighter.

name: Savage Agility
text: This fighter is a Hunter. Reaction: After a failed Range 1 or Range 2 Attack action that targets this fighter, deal 1 damage to the attacker.

name: Stuff of Nightmares
text: Choose one enemy fighter within 2 hexes of a friendly fighter and roll one attack dice. On a roll of :atSmash:, deal 1 damage to the chosen fighter.

name: Fuelled by Sensation
text: Choose one friendly fighter. Pick one: Heal (1) that fighter, or deal 1 damage to that fighter.

name: Lacerating Barnacles
text: Domain Reaction: After an enemy fighter ends a Move action adjacent to this fighter, roll one magic dice. During a round in which one or more Domain gambits were played, roll two magic dice instead. On a roll of one or more :MagFocus: deal 1 damage to that enemy fighter.

name: Grievous Gyre
text: Reaction: Play this after a friendly fighter's Range 1 or Range 2 Attack action. Scatter 4 from that fighter's hex and push that fighter up to 3 hexes along the chain. If the chain is interrupted, or if the fighter would be pushed into a hex that is blocked or occupied, do not push them further.

name: Kurnoth's Snare
text: Surge: Score this immediately when an enemy fighter is pushed into a lethal hex.

name: Spinning Menace
text: +1 Dice and Scything to this fighter's Range 1 Attack actions, other than Attack actions with Combo. To resolve this fighter's Move action, Scatter 3 from this fighter's hex and push this fighter along the chain to the end hex. If this fighter cannot be pushed into a hex, the push ends in the last hex in the chain this fighter can occupy.

name: Dangerous Prize
text: Pick one objective token in an empty hex. The first fighter to move into, be pushed into or be placed in the same hex as that objective token in the next activation is dealt 1 damage.

name: Desperate Flight
text: Choose one friendly fighter and Scatter 4 from that fighter's hex. Push that fighter 3 hexes along the chain. If a hex that fighter would be pushed into is blocked or occupied, do not push that fighter any further.

name: Shattershard
text: Choose an enemy fighter, and choose one of their upgrades. Roll an attack dice. On a roll of :atSmash: or :atCrit: that upgrade is discarded.

name: Kunnin'
text: Start of the first Action step each battle round, if your leader is on the battlefield: you may discard an Upgrade equipped by a friendly fighter, then add a Ploy from your Power discard pile to your hand (each Ploy at most once per game).

name: Arcane Siphon
text: Action: Choose one enemy fighter within three hexes of this fighter. Pick one of that fighter's upgrades. That upgrade is discarded. Roll an attack dice. On a roll of :atSmash: or :atCrit: discard this card.

name: Bestial Transformation
text: Choose one friendly fighter. Discard that fighter's upgrades. That fighter's Range 1 Attack actions have Cleave and Ensnare and each enemy fighter is a Quarry. This effect persists until that fighter is given an upgrade, or until that fighter is taken out of action.

name: Skritch is the Greatest, Yes-yes
text: Score this immediately if your leader takes an enemy fighter out of action.

name: Killing Strike
text: Surge: Score this immediately after an activation in which a friendly fighter's Attack action took an enemy fighter out of action, if that was your first activation in this round.

name: Spiteful Dart
text: Reaction: Play this after an enemy fighter's Attack action that drives a friendly fighter back, if the friendly fighter is not taken out of action. The enemy fighter is dealt 1 damage.

name: Beautiful Deaths
text: Dual: Score this in an end phase if: There are three or more surviving friendly fighters And: Three or more enemy fighters are out of action.

name: Sting of the Ur-Grub
text: Ur-grub Aspect +1 Damage to this fighter's Range 1 Attack actions. If this fighter has three or more Ur-grub Aspects, remove those cards from the game (they do not go into a discard pile) and give the Avatar of the Ur-grub upgrade to this fighter.

name: Oath of Annihilation
text: You may reveal this card at the start of your first activation in the action phase, then return it to your hand. Score this in an end phase if all enemy fighters are out of action. If you revealed this card, gain 1 additional glory point.

name: Lender's Lockbox
text: Reaction: After this fighter is removed from the battlefield, pick one of their upgrades and return it to your hand.

name: Oath of Supremacy
text: You may reveal this card at the start of your first activation in the action phase, then return it to your hand. Score this in an end phase if you hold three or more objectives. If you revealed this card, gain 1 additional glory point.

name: Plunder the Graves
text: Shuffle your power discard pile face down, then draw the top card. Return that card to your hand.

name: Oath of Conquest
text: You may reveal this card at the start of your first activation in the action phase, then return it to your hand. Score this in the third end phase if all surviving friendly fighters are in enemy territory. If you revealed this card, gain 1 additional glory point.

name: Light of the Stars
text: Reaction: Play this after an opponent plays a gambit. That gambit deals no damage.

name: Deathless Warriors
text: At the start of the deal damage step for each enemy fighter's Attack action that targets a friendly Mortek, roll one defence dice. On a roll of :dfCrit:, that Attack action deals no damage, the combat sequence ends and you discard this card. This effect persists until the end of the round.

name: Wall of Force
text: [:Hex: 3 - :MagChannel: - - :boom: 0] This Attack action deals no damage when it is successful. It has Knockback X, where X is the number of successes in the attack roll.

name: Cover of Darkness
text: Pick one: Gambits cannot deal damage. This effect persists until the end of the next power step. Or: Push one friendly fighter up to 2 hexes into a cover hex.

name: Silence
text: Choose an enemy fighter. They cannot attempt to cast spells for the remainder of the power step.

name: Stealthy Blade
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: 2] Players cannot use reactions during this Attack action.

name: Prayers of the Faithful
text: This card cannot be played in an opponent's third or fourth power step. Until the end of the next power step, enemy fighters cannot cast spells and opponents cannot play ploy cards.

name: Tenebrous Form
text: Choose one friendly fighter. That fighter's Defence characteristic is :dfDodge: 3. That fighter cannot make attack actions or reactions, cannot cast spells, cannot be on Guard, cannot hold objectives and cannot be driven back. This effect persists until the end of the phase, or until that fighter is taken out of action.

name: Danse of Deintalos
text: Gambit Spell (:MagChannel::MagChannel:): If cast, pick Move or Attack. Each friendly Inspired conductive fighter can make an action of the kind you picked. Players cannot use reactions while this spell is being resolved.

name: Gotcha!
text: Reaction: Play this after a friendly fighter's successful Trap Launcher Attack action that does not take the target out of action. Give the target one Move token.

name: Screaming Demise
text: Reaction: During an enemy fighter's Attack action, after the deal damage step, if that Attack action dealt enough damage to this fighter to take them out of action, choose one enemy fighter and then discard this card. Give the chosen fighter one Charge token.

name: Voltane Eel
text: [:Hex: 3 - :atFury: 3 - :boom: 1] On a critical hit, give the target one Move token.

name: Whispers of Chaos
text: Gambit Spell (:MagFocus:): If cast, choose one enemy fighter within 3 hexes of the caster. Push that fighter up to 1 hex, then pick one: deal 1 damage to that fighter, or give that fighter one Move token.

name: Headlong Fury
text: Choose one Inspired friendly fighter. The chosen fighter makes a Move action. Do not give the chosen fighter a Move token for that action.

name: Hatred of the Living
text: You can re-roll one attack dice in this fighter's attack rolls for Range 1 and Range 2 Attack actions. Reaction: During an Attack action that targets this fighter, before the deal damage step, reduce the Damage characteristic of that Attack action by 1, to a minimum of 1, then discard this card.

name: Punishing Blow
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 3 - :boom: 4 -(Cleave)-] After a fighter makes this Attack action, discard this card.

name: Narrowing Passage
text: Choose one enemy Quarry with one or more upgrades, or pick one opponent: that opponent chooses one fighter in their warband with one or more upgrades. Discard one of that fighter's upgrades at random.

name: Amberbone Axe
text: [:Hex: 3 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: 1] After this fighter makes this Attack action, discard this card. [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: 2] If this Attack action takes an enemy fighter out of action, discard this card and gain 1 glory point.

name: Greedy Gauntlet
text: Reaction: After this fighter's activation, deal 1 damage to this fighter and place one Sacrifice counter on this card. +1 Damage to this fighter's Range 1 or Range 2 Attack actions for each Sacrifice counter on this card.

name: Soultrap
text: Reaction: During an Attack action or ploy that takes this fighter out of action, roll a defence dice. If you roll a :dfBlock: or :dfCrit: they suffer no damage and are not taken out of action, and you discard this upgrade.

name: Amberbone Mace
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: 2] You can re-roll any number of dice in the attack roll. If this Attack action takes an enemy fighter out of action, discard this card and gain 1 glory point.

name: Nullstone Axe
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: 2] You can re-roll one dice in the attack roll if the target is a wizard [:Hex: 3 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: 1] After a fighter makes this Attack action, discard this upgrade. You can re-roll one dice in the attack roll if the target is a wizard.

name: Amberbone Dagger
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atFury: 3 - :boom: 2] If there are one or more :atCrit: in the attack roll, this Attack action has Cleave. If this Attack action takes an enemy fighter out of action, discard this card and gain 1 glory point.

name: Dark Judgement
text: Surge, Dual: Score this immediately after: A friendly fighter's Attack action if the target was taken out of action And: The attacker and/or the defender was in a cover hex in enemy territory.

name: One Step Ahead
text: You can only play this card in the final power step of a round. Choose an opponent and name an objective, then roll an attack dice. On a roll of :atSmash: or :atCrit: that opponent cannot score that objective in the subsequent end phase.

name: Inspired Command
text: Choose a friendly fighter (other than your leader) and push them up to one hex or put them on Guard. You can only play this if your leader is on the battlefield.

name: Grimnir Commands
text: The first friendly fighter (other than your leader) to make a Move action (not as part of a Charge action) in the next activation has +2 Move. You can only play this if your leader is on the battlefield.

name: Quick Advance
text: Choose up to two friendly fighters (other than your leader) and push each of them up to one hex. You can only play this if your leader is on the battlefield.

name: Gifted Sight
text: Mutation This fighter is an explorer. Blocked hexes do not block line of sight for this fighter. Reaction: After a friendly fighter's Attack action that takes an enemy fighter out of action, if this card is in your hand, give this upgrade to that friendly fighter. This does not cost any glory points.

name: Irresistible Challenge
text: Reaction: During an adjacent enemy fighter's Attack action, before any dice are rolled, change the target of that Attack action to this fighter and discard this card.

name: Desperate Swing
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atFury: 2 - :boom: 2 -(Combo)-] If any opponent has more glory points than you, this Attack action has +2 Dice.

name: Inescapable Blow
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: 2] Reaction: After this fighter's successful Attack action with Combo, make this Attack action. It must target the same fighter and has Cleave and Ensnare.

name: Spiralling Confusion
text: Choose one friendly fighter and one enemy fighter adjacent to that fighter. Do the following for each chosen fighter: Scatter 1 from the chosen fighter's hex and push that fighter along the chain to the end hex. If the chain is interrupted, or if the fighter would be pushed into a hex that is blocked or occupied, do not push them.

name: Rivers of Blood
text: Score this in an end phase if all surviving fighters (at least four) are wounded.

name: Illusory Find
text: Reveal cards from the top of your power deck one by one until you reveal an Illusion upgrade. Add that card to your hand, then return the revealed cards to your power deck and shuffle your power deck. If you did not reveal an Illusion upgrade, return the revealed cards to your power deck and shuffle your power deck.

name: Amberbone Flute
text: Reaction: After this fighter's activation, give this fighter a Charge token, then reveal cards from the top of your power deck one by one until you reveal a Denizen upgrade. Add that card to your hand. Then, or if you did not reveal a Denizen upgrade, place the revealed cards in your power deck and shuffle that deck.

name: Fulminating Hymn
text: At the start of the combat phase choose one hymn; while you have 2 or more friendly fighters, each can use it: Charged Aura (friendly fighters cannot be Flanked), Reckless Abandon (instead of taking a Charge token, a fighter may take 1 damage), Faithful Dynamos (friendly weapons have Stagger).

name: Schemin' Gitz
text: Instead of playing a Ploy in the opponent's Power step, discard Ploys for effects that last until the end of your next turn and add up: 1 card, friendly fighters +1 Move; 2, enemies are Flanked; 3, friendly weapons +1 Attack dice.

name: Part of Da Plan
text: Once per game, after picking an Attack's target that is Flanked or Surrounded: certain dice results also count as successes (symbols did not extract).

name: Scheming Pack
text: Friendly melee weapons have Grievous against targets that are Flanked or Surrounded.

name: Deny Trespassers
text: Friendly fighters in friendly territory cannot be Flanked or Surrounded.

name: Brutal Attack
text: +1 Dice to the first Attack action made by a friendly fighter in the next activation. After that Attack action, place one Waaagh! counter on that fighter's fighter card.

name: The Restless Dead
text: Power step, once per game: push up to 3 friendly minions or fighters with Health 3 or less 1 hex each.

name: Corpse Explosion
text: Once per game: pick a friendly minion, or a friendly fighter with Health 3 or less, adjacent to an enemy; inflict 1 damage on each adjacent enemy, then inflict damage on the picked fighter until it is slain.

name: Deadly Swarm
text: Attack action, Denizen [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: - -(Ensnare, Swarm)-] Swarm: The Damage characteristic is equal to the number of Denizen upgrades this fighter has. This Attack action's characteristics cannot be modified.

name: Flickering Step
text: Roll eight dice. Choose a friendly fighter and push them up to a number of hexes equal to the number of :atCrit: rolled.

name: Threshing Throw
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: - - :boom: 2 -(Scything)-] The Dice characteristic is equal to the number of adjacent enemy fighters. If this fighter is a Nurgle fighter, this Attack action has Ensnare.

name: Fated Blade
text: [:Hex: 1 - :atSmash: 2 - :boom: -] Roll five attack dice each time this Attack action succeeds. Its Damage characteristic is equal to the number of :atSmash: and :atCrit: rolled.

name: Shock Troops
text: Surge, Hybrid: Score this immediately after an activation if: One or more friendly fighters hold an objective in enemy territory that has a number equal to the number of that fighter's upgrades Or: One or more friendly fighters each have more upgrades than there are surviving enemy fighters.

name: Possessed Weapon
text: After each Attack action with a Range of 1 or 2 this fighter makes, they suffer 1 damage. Their Attack actions with a Range of 1 or 2 have +1 Damage.

name: Feral Symbiote
text: +1 Damage to this fighter's Range 1 Attack actions. After this fighter's activation, give this fighter 1 Hunger counter. Then, if this fighter has 3 or more Hunger counters, deal 1 damage to this fighter.

name: Sorcerous Insight
text: Gambit Spell (:MagFocus::MagFocus:): If this spell is cast, choose one ploy from your discard pile and add it to your hand.

name: Infinite Riches
text: Gambit Spell (:MagChannel::MagChannel:): If this spell is cast, choose one upgrade from your power discard pile and add it to your hand.

name: Scroll of Recall
text: Reaction: After this fighter's gambit spell is resolved, discard this card and roll a magic dice. On a roll of :MagChannel:, place the gambit spell on top of your power deck instead of on your power discard pile.

name: Carnivores All
text: Starting with you, each player can choose one or more fighters from their warband. Give each chosen fighter one Hunger counter. Each fighter with two or more Hunger counters is a Hunter. This effect persists until the end of the round.

name: Divide and Conquer
text: Score this in an end phase if each player has at least one fighter in their own territory and at least one fighter in enemy territory.

name: Tome of Insight
text: (Errata update) Katophrane Tome Action: Choose an opponent. They must reveal the power cards in their hand to you.

name: Capable Poisoners
text: Dual: Score this in an end phase if: Your warband made one or more successful Attack actions in the preceding phase And: Two or more surviving friendly fighters each have one or more poison upgrades.

name: Quick Opener
text: Reaction: Play this after you give a friendly fighter an Attack action upgrade with Combo. That fighter makes that Attack action.

name: Blazing Soul
text: This fighter is Inspired and cannot be un-Inspired. This upgrade cannot be applied to a fighter that cannot be Inspired.

name: Looting the Remains
text: Score this in an end phase if one or more enemy fighters that are out of action each have two or more upgrades.

name: Draining Leech
text: [:Hex: 3 - :atFury: 3 - :boom: 1] This Attack action's Damage characteristic cannot be modified. After this fighter makes this Attack action, discard this upgrade. Reaction: After the deal damage step, pick one of the target's upgrades. Discard that upgrade.

name: No Time
text: No more power cards can be played until after the next activation.

name: Atmospheric Isolation
text: Play this only if there is a surviving friendly Thundrik. No more power cards can be played until after the next activation.

name: Devoted Curse
text: Reaction: After this fighter's activation, put one Devotion token on a feature token within 2 hexes of this fighter. While a feature token has one or more Devotion tokens on it, the hex containing that feature token is a lethal hex in addition to its other types. Remove all Devotion tokens from the battlefield at the end of the round.

name: Hunter
text: From card text: Hunter fighters gain bonuses against fighters marked as Quarry.

name: Gauntlet of Dominance
text: Mortis Relic If this fighter has two or more Mortis Relics, +1 Damage to this fighter's Range 1 and Range 2 Attack actions. Reaction: After this fighter's activation, spend 1 glory point. If you do, push one enemy fighter 1 hex.

name: Fountain of Gore
text: Reaction: Play this after an Attack action or ploy that takes a fighter out of action. All friendly fighters have +1 Defence in the next activation.

name: Cyreni Inspire
text: At the start of each combat phase, Inspire as many friendly fighters as the battle round number; at the start of each round, Uninspire each friendly fighter.

name: Purge the Weak
text: Once per game: pick an enemy with a Stagger token; until the next turn friendly melee weapons get +1 Attack dice against it.

name: Great Cunning
text: Reaction: Play this after you play a power card in the power step. You can immediately play another power card. You can only play this if your leader is on the battlefield.

name: Wicked Hunter
text: Poison Reaction: After you play a poison gambit, push this fighter 1 hex, then stagger each enemy fighter adjacent to this fighter.

name: The Trap is Sprung
text: Reaction: Play this after you play a Trap gambit. Pick one: choose one friendly fighter adjacent to one or more enemy fighters and give the chosen fighter one Guard token, or choose one friendly fighter that is not within 2 hexes of an enemy fighter and push the chosen fighter up to 2 hexes.

name: Dusklure Bracers
text: Reaction: Use this after this fighter is dealt damage while in a cover hex, after the deal damage step. Choose an enemy fighter within 2 hexes of this fighter. Deal 1 damage to the chosen fighter.

name: Outrageous Fortune
text: Reaction: Play this after a friendly fighter is dealt damage in the deal damage step. Pick one of that fighter's upgrades and discard it. If you do, reduce that damage by 1 to a minimum of 1.

name: Addicted to Power
text: Surge: Score this immediately after a friendly fighter is dealt damage by backlash, if that fighter is not taken out of action.

name: Dinner Time
text: Surge: Score this immediately when an enemy fighter Moves into, is pushed into or is placed in the same hex as a friendly Trap model.

name: Soul Harvest
text: Power step, once per game: pick an Inspired enemy; its owner chooses to Uninspire it or let you draw Power cards equal to the battle round.

name: 'Ave 'Is Ya Git!
text: Once per game, immediately after an enemy Charges: a friendly fighter adjacent to the charger may Attack it.

name: The Crown's Curse
text: Reaction: After the first power step in a round, place one friendly Grave Guard that is out of action on a starting hex in your territory. Give that fighter one Raise counter. Then give that fighter wound counters until that fighter is vulnerable. While this fighter has one or more Command counters: +1 Dice to this fighter's Baleful Tomb Blade and this fighter is uninspired and cannot be inspired.

name: Lurelight
text: When an enemy fighter is taken out of action while adjacent to this fighter, that fighter's player pick one: you gain 1 glory point, or that player discards one power card.

name: Zealous Defender
text: This fighter is considered to have an additional supporting fighter while they are holding an objective.

name: Brethren Inspire
text: Friendly fighters start the game Inspired; after an Action step in which a friendly fighter was conducting, Inspire it; after a friendly fighter's successful Attack, Uninspire it.

name: Slickrock
text: Trap Reaction: Play this after an enemy fighter's Move action that ends in the same hex as an objective token. Scatter 1 from that hex and push that enemy fighter to the end of the chain. If that enemy fighter cannot be pushed into a hex, that fighter is not pushed.

name: Quickroots
text: Trap Reaction: Play this after an enemy fighter's activation, if that fighter has one or more Move and/or Charge tokens. Deal 1 damage to that fighter.

name: Bound Spirit
text: Trap, Denizen Reaction: Play this after an enemy fighter's activation if that fighter is adjacent to one or more feature tokens that are in the same hex as a friendly fighter. Deal 1 damage to that enemy fighter.

name: Master of Tactics
text: If this fighter is on the battlefield, at the beginning of the round you can draw one objective card. If you do so, discard one objective card.

name: Entropic Curse
text: Gambit Spell (:MagFocus:): If this spell is cast, choose an enemy fighter within four hexes of the caster. That fighter suffers 1 damage at the beginning of each round, before the first activation. This spell persists until that fighter is out of action.

name: Dug In
text: Dual: Score this in an end phase If: Your warband holds three or more objectives And: Your warband held three or more objectives at the start of the round.
